About SpotOn
We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh*t about helping restaurants succeed.
Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2 (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users
Rated the top-rated point-of-sale (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users
Awarded Great Places to Work and Built In’s Best Workplaces for multiple years running
We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.
About The Role
We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our Hospitality Fulfillment team at SpotOn. Our domain focus on how customers’ orders actually get to the kitchen and are prepared, so the work you’ll be doing is critical for smooth restaurant operation. You'll work across various backend services and microfrontends to build features that power our Express POS.
The Ideal Candidate Will Be Able To
Take extreme ownership: You don’t just close tickets; you own the outcome. If a feature breaks or a customer is stuck, you’re the one who sees the fix through, regardless of where the problem sits in the stack.
Navigate real complexity: We aren’t doing simple CRUD work. You will be untangling massive systems and solving high-stakes puzzles that require creative thinking and the grit to push through frustration.
Be a "whatever it takes" engineer: You are flexible. If the frontend lead is out or an infra fire starts, you’re ready to jump in, learn what you don't know, and clear the path for the team.
Treat AI as a teammate: We use AI tools daily to move faster. You’ll be expected to leverage these tools to solve "impossible" problems and keep our quality bar high.
Drive the team forward: You’ll provide technical leadership, ensuring we’re making smart decisions and addressing tech debt before it becomes a roadblock.
What skill are we searching for?
Real-world experience: You’ve spent at least 5 to 7 years building software that survives high-traffic, production environments.
Backend mastery: You are highly proficient in Golang and ideally also JS/TS.
AI fluency: You have already integrated AI into your workflow and know how to use it to write better code and debug complex systems.
Solid fundamentals: You have a deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns that allow you to build for scale.
Strong communication: You have a solid command of English (min. B2).
Perfect Candidate Also Has
The "Figure it Out" gene: You actually enjoy the challenge of a problem that doesn’t have a clear answer on the first page of a search result.
Full-stack flexibility: You aren’t afraid of PHP if that’s what’s needed to get a project across the finish line.
Cloud and Infra comfort: You’ve spent enough time with AWS, Terraform, or Kubernetes to understand how your code lives in the wild.
A mentoring mindset: you naturally raise the bar for those around you through thoughtful code reviews and shared knowledge.
What's in it for you
Compensation
Our base pay range for this role is $123,000-175,000/year.
Please note the salary range listed is just one component of a competitive compensation package which includes a company stock plan.
Offers will be reflective of the candidate’s location and experience.
Benefits
At SpotOn, we put people above everything else. We’re known for our innovative software and technology solutions, but we stand out because of the hardworking humans behind the tech. We can’t take care of our clients without taking care of our employees first, and that’s why we invest in your wellbeing with a competitive benefits package designed to support your health, family, and future:
Medical, Dental, and Vision Options: Nationwide plans to fit your personal healthcare needs.
HSA with Employer Match: High-deductible health plan enrollees receive an annual company contribution to their Health Savings Account
Company-Paid Life Insurance & Disability
401(k) Retirement Savings & Annual Employer Match
Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits

Paid vacation, 10 company holidays (including 1 floating holiday), sick time, and volunteer time off
Monthly cell phone and internet stipend

Overview
Senior Presales Engineer, IGA
Location:
Remote — United States or Canada |
Travel:
Some travel required
One Identity believes that an IT security strategy aligned to business needs is essential to future growth and innovation. Our solutions help customers protect their enterprise, comply with internal governance policies and external regulations, and adopt new applications and technologies securely. We help customers create and maintain a strong security foundation with interconnected solutions spanning endpoint, data center , and cloud environments. One Identity solutions mitigate risk and reduce complexity so organizations can move their business forward.
We are looking for a
Senior Presales Engineer, IGA
to support Sales with existing and prospective accounts and partners across the North American market. In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert for One Identity’s Identity Governance and Administration solutions, advise customers on new and revised software solutions, develop integrated end-to-end solution approaches, and position One Identity software to help customers achieve their strategic, operational, security, and compliance goals.
The successful candidate will work as part of a broader Identity and Access Management team and will provide a high standard of presales support for One Identity’s IGA portfolio. Strong communication skills, technical credibility, and deep IGA domain knowledge are essential.
Responsibilities
Support the sales process with strong technical knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration, IAM, and enterprise security use cases.
Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer business objectives, identity lifecycle processes, governance requirements, compliance obligations, and technical environments.
Map customer technical requirements to business outcomes and recommend appropriate One Identity IGA solution approaches.
Deliver technical and sales-oriented presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concepts for customers and partners.
Assist Sales with customer needs assessments, solution positioning, technical proposals, detailed specifications, and RFP/RFI responses.
Articulate the value proposition of One Identity products and services, including how IGA integrates with broader IAM, PAM, Access Management, directory, cloud, and hybrid environments.
Collaborate with Product Management, Product Development, Professional Services, Support, Customer Success, and P artner teams to support successful customer outcomes.
Represent One Identity at customer meetings, industry events, conferences, webinars, and trade shows.
Provide guidance and mentoring to less experienced peers and contribute to presales enablement, repeatable demos, and reusable technical assets.
Maintain responsiveness to customers, partners, and internal teams while managing multiple opportunities in a remote, distributed work environment.
Qualifications
10+ years of overall related experience or combination of education and experience.
3+ years of relevant experience as a Presales/Systems Engineer
Deep knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration concepts, including identity lifecycle management, joiner/mover/leaver processes, access requests, approvals, provisioning, attestation, certification, role management, segregation of duties, audit reporting, and compliance controls.
Extensive hands-on experience selling, designing, deploying, consulting on, or architecting IGA, IAM, directory, access management, or privileged access solutions in real-world enterprise environments.
Proven ability to architect end-to-end solutions, translate complex business and governance requirements into practical technical designs, and apply lessons learned from prior implementations and consulting engagements.
Strong understanding of the customer journey and enterprise buying decision, including how organizations evaluate, justify, and procure identity solutions, and the ability to guide prospects through that process.
Strong understanding of enterprise directories and identity platforms, including Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP, HR systems, ERP platforms, SaaS applications, and hybrid cloud environments.
Working knowledge of APIs, REST, SCIM, connectors, integration patterns, and identity data synchronization.
Knowledge of databases such as SQL Server or Oracle and familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, J ava , C#, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
Understanding of core application and security concepts, including SSL/TLS, encryption, password hashing, authentication, authorization, and secure integration practices.
Thorough understanding of the cybersecurity industry, competitive landscape, cloud ecosystem, and key identity security technologies.
Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, information systems, cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage and influence a range of stakeholders across the client organization—from administrators and engineers to security, compliance, and IT leadership, and executive decision-makers—tailoring complex technical concepts to each audience.
Independent, self-motivated, customer-oriented, analytical, and able to work effectively both individually and as part of a team.
Ability and willingness to travel as needed.
Company Description
One Identity enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyze information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward. With team members around the globe, we intend to continue to grow revenues and add value to customers.
When you join our team, you will have the opportunity to build and develop products at a scale few others can provide. Our product portfolio serves a large base of customers, and we are addressing the strategic imperatives for enterprise businesses.

description_preview:
About Liquid AI
Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there.
The Opportunity
Our Data team powers Liquid Foundation Models across pre-training, vision, audio, and emerging modalities. Public data sources are plateauing. Model performance increasingly depends on purpose-built datasets. We need ML-minded engineers who can collect, filter, and synthesize high-quality data at scale.
We treat data as a research problem, not an infrastructure problem. Our engineers run experiments, design ablations, and measure how data decisions move model quality. We will match you to the team where you can grow the fastest and have the most impact: pre-training, post-training RL, vision-language, audio, or multimodal.
While San Francisco and Boston are preferred, we are open to other locations.
What We're Looking For
We need someone who:
Thinks like a researcher, ships like an engineer: We need people who form hypotheses, run experiments, and measure results. Our engineers understand deep-theoretical research, and our researchers ship production systems.
Learns fast and adapts: We work across modalities that evolve weekly. We need people who pick up new domains quickly and thrive with ambiguity.
Obsesses over data quality: We believe data quality is non-negotiable. Filtering, deduplication, augmentation, and evaluation are first-class concerns for our team, not afterthoughts.
Solves problems independently: Our data engineers sit within training groups (pre-training and multimodal). We collaborate closely, but we expect ownership and self-direction.
The Work
Build and maintain data processing, filtering, and selection pipelines at scale
Create pipelines for pretraining, midtraining, SFT, and preference optimization datasets
Design synthetic data generation systems using LLMs, structured prompting, and domain-specific generators
Design and run evaluations and ablations to measure dataset's impact on model performance
Monitor public datasets across text, vision, and audio domains
Collaborate with pre-training, vision, and audio teams on modality-specific data needs
Must-have
Desired Experience
Strong Python skills with the ability to quickly comprehend problems and translate them into clean, working code
Solid ML fundamentals: experience training, evaluating, and iterating on models (PyTorch preferred)
Track record of learning new technical domains quickly
3+ years relevant experience with an M.S., or 1+ year with a Ph.D. (5+ years with a B.S.)
Nice-to-have
Experience with synthetic data generation, data curation, or ML evaluation (designing evals, benchmarking, measuring data and model quality)
Experience with LLMs, VLMs, computer vision, or audio data pipelines
Open-source contributions or publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or CVPR
What Success Looks Like (Year One)
You own a critical data pipeline end-to-end for one of our modalities
You have built or improved data systems that measurably moved model performance
You have identified and integrated at least one external dataset that moved the needle
What We Offer
Impact at scale: Your pipelines directly determine model quality across all of Liquid's foundation models.
Compensation: Competitive base salary with equity in a unicorn-stage company
Health: We pay 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and dependents
Financial: 401(k) matching up to 4% of base pay
Time Off: Unlimited PTO plus company-wide Refill Days throughout the year
